coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Mission Bay Branch Library
record.summary: The Mission Bay Branch Library, a single-story San Francisco Public Library branch at 960 4th St that opened on July 8, 2006 (SFPL); the Assessor roll lists a 2005 year built.

milestones.text: Official groundbreaking for the Mission Bay Branch Library, a 7,500 sq ft branch at 960 4th St (funded by the $105.9M Branch Library Improvement Program bond measure approved by voters in Nov 2000)

changes.text: The summary now says the library opened July 8, 2006 (SFPL's history page) instead of leading with the Assessor's 2005 year built. The Phil'z Coffee entry no longer gives an opening date: 2007-04-01 is a business-registration date in DataSF, and Phil'z's own locations page only shows the 201 Berry St store operating now. The record's notes no longer call the Assessor's 201 Berry St address stale, since Phil'z is registered at that address, and now cite the DataSF Assessor roll and parcels.

changes.text: Phil'z Coffee's own locations page (philzcoffee.com/locations, read 2026-09-29) lists a Berry store at 201 Berry St with opening hours. DataSF Registered Business Locations shows a registration there with a location start date of 2007-04-01, which is a registration date, not a confirmed opening date, so no opening date is given.

The Mission Bay Branch Library's completion date corrected. The earlier entry gave a rough 2005 year from a weak guess based on DataSF Assessor data. SFPL's own "Facts & Figures" PDF, already checked directly and confirmed during earlier research verification, states the actual grand opening was July 8, 2006, and adds a Dec 10, 2003 groundbreaking as a real earlier stage. The confirmed date had not been applied to the record at the time; this was caught on a later re-check.

open_questions: Pier & Point's own field photos are shown on this record. Its summary is limited to what its cited source was re-read to confirm on 2026-09-27; fuller details shown in this record's map notes (developer, architect, unit count, year built) were left out where that source didn't state them. Not yet researched: no milestones, costs or facts.

Phil'z Coffee at 201 Berry St: DataSF Registered Business Locations gives a registration start of 2007-04-01, which is not an opening date, and no source found dates the opening; the tenant's own locations page (philzcoffee.com/locations) lists the Berry St store as of 2026-09-29.

record.notes: Mission Bay Branch Library, 960 4th St -- San Francisco Public Library branch, 7,499 sq ft, single story, built 2005 (DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Roll: property class 'LIBRARY', year built 2005). Block/lot 8708110 confirmed against DataSF's Assessor parcels (address number 960, street 04TH ST); the Assessor tax roll's own property location for this block/lot reads '201 BERRY ST', a different street address from the library's 4th St address (Phil'z Coffee is registered at that same 201 Berry St address).
